Design.evidence_source: [/page/18/Text/5] The CIG Only and Hidden Information treatments described above represent two different sorting environments. In the former, the information is given exogenously to all participants so there is no opportunity to sort into different information states. In the latter, participants can freely choose or avoid information, so those who know that they are in the CIG are self-selected.
